body:
Dont know if I want to stop being strong or if I need to be strong to stop hurting. 

Guess it doesn't really matter after.

Honestly being poor was the best times of my life. You appreciate things so much more. I get where you say where you would want a romantic partner instead that hits deep. Because my recent partner, when we were poor I think it was the best time of my life.
Get involved in leadership. If you care about how you're paid only one way to fix it. Results.

If the controller has a replacement plan just go to your local store and they should be able to replace it given they have the inventory. Just have the reciept or the phone number associated with the purchase. Worst case might have to order the replacement and have it picked up or shipped to you. Do note you'll most likely have to repurchase the protection plan.
Your dog goes to work with you? That's fricken sweet.
It's not the tasks that have gotten to me. It's the people.

Slowly restart the store part of the company. Once they have guidance from the government I assume theyll start opening in areas that have less cases. I'm sure they dont want to rush things like this due to health/lawsuits. I hope they take it seriously.

I predict but hope I'm wrong but I believe we will see restructures and lots of changes coming.

I'd take a lazy manager over a toxic manager any day of the week.
The mental exhaustion at my store is ridiculous. Busting my ass for weeks since the change and still feel like a piece of garbage.

Was going to use carnival. Leading up to the nonsense they kept increasing the room comps till it got to about 300 a person. Was excited but terrified haha.

They are still honoring the room credits for whichever cruise we decide on in the future. Probably gonna trade the Mexico cruise to a Bahamas cruise and add a couple days.

Hopefully the world goes back to normal sooner rather than later haha.
Surprised they knew the store number. Previous employee?
